name: Zigup Plc
summary: Zigup Plc engages in the provision of mobility solutions to business and personal customers in the United Kingdom, Spain, and Ireland. It operates through the three reportable segments: UK&I Rental, Spain Rental, and Claims & Services. The company offers vehicle provision services that include vehicle rental, service, and maintenance solutions through vans, e-LCVs, and specialist vehicles with refrigerated, traffic management, and support; and fleet support and services comprising service scheduling, telematics, driver liaison, training, and downtime management, as well as electric vehicle (EV) fleet consulting.
